primary_statistic: Mean correct forecast lead per measured positive trial, assigning zero to missed and premature alerts. Greater lead is useful only without additional benign or premature false alerts. Report paired deployment differences and exploratory cluster bootstrap; only three test deployments limits inference.
primary: Compare predefined hgb_history with the strongest statistical comparator chosen ONLY on calibration deployments. Match calibration early/premature false-alert budget. Report test detection, benign/premature false alerts, lead times, eligibility and deployment-cluster uncertainty. Publish negative outcomes.
outcome: First of three consecutive batches with >=2 verified signed replies and median measured UE RTT >200ms. Outcome comes from measured replies, never from injection settings. A trial without this outcome is negative even if nominally gradual.
forecast_eligibility: At least8 past/current rows; >=2 current verified receipts; current median RTT<=200ms; no hard integrity alarm; signed two-NF evidence age<=6s; runtime witness present. End-of-trial horizon is censored. Coverage is reported. During UE downtime no forecast is claimed.
alert_protocol: One first threshold crossing per eligible trial prefix. On a positive trial credit only when first alert precedes measured SLO onset by <=8s; earlier alerts are premature false alerts and do not earn later detection credit. Thresholds are frozen before test. Fixed trial boundaries are part of this laboratory design, not continuous production deployment.
actuation: Only bounded netem delay on the test UE uesimtun0 interface and <=6 ordinary nonce probes per batch, internal Docker network. No malicious packets, exploitation, process pauses or external targets. This tests gradual application-path latency, not NF compromise or semantic attacks.
trust: Retain original AUSF/NSSF KIE/CU and host runtime signer. Application witness uses a distinct guest kernel. Shared host/hypervisor remains trusted; no hardware attestation and no independent NF identity oracle.
leakage: No injected delay, future load, case name/order, identifiers, absolute timestamps or future replies in model features. Actual observed request count and observed UE state are permitted context. Classifiers share the same current/past observations. No test deployments in fitting or threshold selection.
scope: Twelve fresh isolated full Open5GS2.7.6 deployments, simulated radio; six training, three calibration, three test. Smoke1199 is excluded. Three test deployments do not certify production false-alarm rates or general attack detection. ML advantage is a hypothesis, not an acceptance criterion.
